universities.summary: Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering is a private autonomous college established in 1985 at Pennalur, Sriperumbudur, near Chennai. Affiliated to Anna University, it offers undergraduate and postgraduate engineering programmes. Its regular undergraduate degrees use English instruction, laboratory and project learning; admissions and tuition depend on the specific applicant category and route.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Pennalur campus combines academic departments, laboratories and a central library with sports and student clubs. The college lists technical associations, a theatre group, Music Club, Tamil Mandram, Rotaract and an Eco Club. Optional undergraduate Honours/Minor study is part of the curriculum rather than a separate first-entry degree.
universities.cityProfile: The teaching campus is at Pennalur Village on the Chennai–Bengaluru Highway, Sriperumbudur taluk 602117, in Tamil Nadu. It is outside central Chennai; assess travel time and the college transport or hostel arrangements before choosing a daily commute. Use TNEA code 1219 and the official svce.ac.in identity when applying: similarly named colleges in Tirupati and other cities are separate institutions.
universities.practicalExposure: UG R 2026 combines theory, practical and employability-enhancement courses, including project work and industrial training where specified in the curriculum. The college prospectus describes department-level Industry–Institute Interaction Cells, workshops, technical quizzes, working-model and software-design activities. Its research centres and innovation facilities provide an academic setting for engineering investigation; participation in training, research or placement support does not guarantee an internship or employment outcome.
universities.hostelOverview: The college provides separate men’s and women’s hostels. The 2026 prospectus describes accommodation capacity above 1,350 and a dining hall serving vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. The first-year DOTE fee sheet lists hostel charges separately from tuition; confirm room allocation, what the quoted charge includes and any additional living costs.
universities.dietarySupport: The 2026 prospectus says the hostel dining hall serves vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, and the campus has a canteen offering food and beverages. Individual allergy requirements, special diets, meal plans and included mess costs need confirmation before choosing accommodation.
universities.safetyOverview: The college describes a campus medical centre, fitness facilities and a round-the-clock ambulance. Its official site provides anti-ragging information, an Internal Complaints Committee and women’s helpline links. These services do not establish an individual safety or medical outcome.
universities.studentSupport: The central library supports online catalogue access and inter-library loans. Department associations, student clubs and the Industry–Institute Interaction Cells support academic and co-curricular participation. The college provides admissions coordinators and counselling contacts for route-specific application questions.

eligibility.intro: These requirements describe academic-stream, first-year admission through the TNEA government-counselling route for this programme.
items: Pass HSC Academic (+1 and +2), or an accepted equivalent, with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry.
Minimum PCM average: General 45%; Tamil Nadu BC/BCM, MBC/DNC and SC/SCA/ST 40%, with the required valid category records.
Indian applicants must satisfy the TNEA schooling, nativity or specified parent-employment conditions for the claimed route.
Communal reservation is for eligible Tamil Nadu native applicants; other eligible categories use Open Competition under TNEA rules.
Admission depends on TNEA rank, branch choices, available surrendered seats and confirmed allotment; the academic minimum does not guarantee a place.

faq.question: Is SVCE a private autonomous college?
faq.answer: Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering is a private college at Pennalur, Sriperumbudur. UGC lists its autonomous status for 2022-23 to 2031-32. Anna University lists it as an affiliated autonomous college with TNEA code 1219; autonomy and affiliation are distinct statuses, not programme accreditation guarantees.

faq.question: Where is the teaching campus?
faq.answer: The campus is at Pennalur Village on the Chennai–Bengaluru Highway, Sriperumbudur taluk 602117. It is outside central Chennai, so compare the daily route with college transport or hostel arrangements. The similarly named institutions in Tirupati and other cities are separate colleges.

faq.question: Which programmes are covered here?
faq.answer: These entries cover the 11 current regular undergraduate engineering branches through the verified TNEA academic-stream route. The college also lists eight postgraduate degrees. PG, research and lateral-entry applicants require separate programme-specific qualification and admission assessment.

faq.question: Are these programmes taught in English?
faq.answer: Yes. UG Academic Regulations 2026 specify English for all courses, examinations, seminar presentations and project/dissertation reports. The regular undergraduate degree takes four academic years across eight semesters; advanced-entry routes have different structures.

faq.question: What are the undergraduate minimum marks?
faq.answer: The academic-stream route requires HSC+1 and+2 or an accepted equivalent with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry. General applicants need 45%average PCM; the listed Tamil Nadu reserved categories need 40%with valid category records. Applicants must also satisfy the applicable TNEA schooling, nativity or parent-employment conditions.

faq.question: How do I apply through the government quota?
faq.answer: Use the notified TNEA registration, verification, rank, choice-filling and allotment process, selecting college code 1219 and the intended branch. Following allotment, complete the college’s enrolment entry and bring the printout, required originals and full fee. The reporting deadline is the one in the allotment order.

faq.question: What is the verified intake timing?
faq.answer: The signed 2026-27 semester-I calendar schedules undergraduate induction from 2 to 15 September 2026 and classes from 16 September 2026. This is the published schedule for that cycle. It does not announce an open application window or promise the timing of a future intake.

faq.question: How much is first-year tuition?
faq.answer: The 2026-27 DOTE General-category tuition is INR 55,000 for Biotechnology, Civil, CSE, Chemical, ECE, EEE, IT and Mechanical. It is INR 50,000 for AI&DS, Mechanical and Automation, and Mechanical Engineering(Automobile). AI&DS has an express NBA-linked revision caveat; all charges may be revised by the Fee Fixation Committee.

faq.question: What costs are separate from tuition?
faq.answer: The first-year DOTE sheet lists development INR 5,000, other academic/service charges INR 83,200 and caution deposit INR 5,000. It adds transport INR 60,000 or hostel INR 135,000. The published General-category first-year totals are INR 203,200–208,200 with transport or INR 278,200–283,200 with hostel, depending on branch; later-year charges are separate.

faq.question: Does the First Graduate rate apply automatically?
faq.answer: No. The DOTE sheet separately labels reduced First Graduate tuition of INR 27,500 or INR 25,000 according to branch. The joining instructions require a Tahsildar first-graduate certificate and a joint parent/student declaration. Scheme eligibility must be approved; other charges remain separate.

faq.question: Are hostels and meals available?
faq.answer: The college provides separate men’s and women’s hostels and describes a dining hall serving vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. The 2026 prospectus lists accommodation capacity above 1,350. Confirm room availability, allocation, included meals and individual dietary needs before accepting accommodation.

faq.question: Can NRI or foreign applicants use these fees?
faq.answer: The tuition and conditions shown here are for the verified domestic DOTE government-quota route. SVCE advertises a separate NRI process with sponsorship and document requirements. Overseas qualifications, applicant categories, foreign/OCI/PIO provisions and tuition need a separate route-specific assessment.

faq.question: What should I check beyond the degree title?
faq.answer: Compare the exact branch curriculum, four-year attendance commitment, travel or hostel plan and complete fee budget. Optional Honours/Minor areas extend an undergraduate curriculum and are not separate first-entry degrees. Practical work, training and placement support do not guarantee employment.

Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering is a private autonomous college established in 1985 at Pennalur, Sriperumbudur, near Chennai. Affiliated to Anna University, it offers undergraduate and postgraduate engineering programmes. Its regular undergraduate degrees use English instruction, laboratory and project learning; admissions and tuition depend on the specific applicant category and route.

The Pennalur campus combines academic departments, laboratories and a central library with sports and student clubs. The college lists technical associations, a theatre group, Music Club, Tamil Mandram, Rotaract and an Eco Club. Optional undergraduate Honours/Minor study is part of the curriculum rather than a separate first-entry degree.

The teaching campus is at Pennalur Village on the Chennai–Bengaluru Highway, Sriperumbudur taluk 602117, in Tamil Nadu. It is outside central Chennai; assess travel time and the college transport or hostel arrangements before choosing a daily commute. Use TNEA code 1219 and the official svce.ac.in identity when applying: similarly named colleges in Tirupati and other cities are separate institutions.

UG R 2026 combines theory, practical and employability-enhancement courses, including project work and industrial training where specified in the curriculum. The college prospectus describes department-level Industry–Institute Interaction Cells, workshops, technical quizzes, working-model and software-design activities. Its research centres and innovation facilities provide an academic setting for engineering investigation; participation in training, research or placement support does not guarantee an internship or employment outcome.

The college provides separate men’s and women’s hostels. The 2026 prospectus describes accommodation capacity above 1,350 and a dining hall serving vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. The first-year DOTE fee sheet lists hostel charges separately from tuition; confirm room allocation, what the quoted charge includes and any additional living costs.

The 2026 prospectus says the hostel dining hall serves vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, and the campus has a canteen offering food and beverages. Individual allergy requirements, special diets, meal plans and included mess costs need confirmation before choosing accommodation.

The college describes a campus medical centre, fitness facilities and a round-the-clock ambulance. Its official site provides anti-ragging information, an Internal Complaints Committee and women’s helpline links. These services do not establish an individual safety or medical outcome.

The central library supports online catalogue access and inter-library loans. Department associations, student clubs and the Industry–Institute Interaction Cells support academic and co-curricular participation. evidence.claimText: How do I apply through the government quota? Use the notified TNEA registration, verification, rank, choice-filling and allotment process, selecting college code 1219 and the intended branch. Following allotment, complete the college’s enrolment entry and bring the printout, required originals and full fee. The reporting deadline is the one in the allotment order.

What is the verified intake timing? The signed 2026-27 semester-I calendar schedules undergraduate induction from 2 to 15 September 2026 and classes from 16 September 2026. What costs are separate from tuition? The first-year DOTE sheet lists development INR 5,000, other academic/service charges INR 83,200 and caution deposit INR 5,000. It adds transport INR 60,000 or hostel INR 135,000. The published General-category first-year totals are INR 203,200–208,200 with transport or INR 278,200–283,200 with hostel, depending on branch; later-year charges are separate.

The joining instructions require a Tahsildar first-graduate certificate and a joint parent/student declaration. Scheme eligibility must be approved; other charges remain separate.

The 2026 prospectus lists accommodation capacity above 1,350. Confirm room availability, allocation, included meals and individual dietary needs before accepting accommodation.

Can NRI or foreign applicants use these fees? The tuition and conditions shown here are for the verified domestic DOTE government-quota route. SVCE advertises a separate NRI process with sponsorship and document requirements. Overseas qualifications, applicant categories, foreign/OCI/PIO provisions and tuition need a separate route-specific assessment.

What should I check beyond the degree title? Compare the exact branch curriculum, four-year attendance commitment, travel or hostel plan and complete fee budget. Optional Honours/Minor areas extend an undergraduate curriculum and are not separate first-entry degrees. Practical work, training and placement support do not guarantee employment.
